title: Vision-guided assembly: replicated full-factorial experiment (data, CAD, and analysis code)
description: Data, part CAD, and analysis code for the article "Assembly Success in a Vision-Guided Robot Cell: A Replicated Full-Factorial Study". The experiment varied part color, part configuration, ambient illuminance, and scanning height in a UR3e cell with a Robotiq wrist camera and 2F-85 gripper (64 conditions, 128 runs, 1280 attempts). The analysis code is released under the MIT License.
